comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop; PR-1444 sets a spring rat trap without allowing a snap or exposing a gripper to the strike path.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate applies coordinated threaded countertorque; PR-1444 restrains a spring-loaded hammer while positioning and latching a separate lock bar.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained angle over three cycles with tools clear; PR-1444 requires the hammer latched back, no snap or unsafe strike-path exposure, and arms clear.
comparison.reason: Both coordinate against a reaction load, but trap setting tests spring restraint and hazard-aware latching rather than locknut-preserved adjustment; no rubric details are missing.
